"""Apply the reviewed, default-secret-scanned S4 document proposal with preimage guards."""
import hashlib,json,runpy,time
from pathlib import Path
E=Path('/Users/mustafaerbay/.codex/zee-evidence/2026-10-14-urunlesme')
R=Path('/Users/mustafaerbay/IdeaProjects/zee-urunlesme-20261014')
P=E/'s4-document-proposal'
S='4b7dd76ad5e10bdf1b16bded82b3ea20ad55a9e2'
O=E/'s4-document-integration'
H=runpy.run_path(str(R/'scripts/lifecycle_core.py'))
H['clean_exact'](R,S)
scan=json.loads((E/'s4-document-proposal-scan-v2/PROOF.json').read_text())
assert scan['status']=='passed' and scan['source_sha']==S and scan['default_policy'] and not scan['custom_allowlist']
assert H['digest'](P/'PREPARATION.json')==scan['proposal_sha256']
proposal=json.loads((P/'PREPARATION.json').read_text())
assert proposal['status']=='prepared-not-applied' and proposal['source_sha']==S
assert not O.exists() and not O.is_symlink()
paths=[]
for x in proposal['files']:
 name=x['path'];src=P/'proposed-files'/name;dest=R/name
 assert Path(name).as_posix()==name and '..' not in Path(name).parts and not Path(name).is_absolute()
 assert name=='README.md' or name.startswith(('docs/','adr/')) or name=='editors/jetbrains/README.md'
 assert not src.is_symlink() and src.stat().st_size==x['bytes'] and H['digest'](src)==x['after_sha256']
 assert dest.resolve().is_relative_to(R.resolve()) and not dest.is_symlink()
 assert (H['digest'](dest) if dest.exists() else None)==x['before_sha256']
 paths.append((x,src,dest))
O.mkdir(mode=0o700)
proof={'schema':'zee-s4-document-integration-1','status':'running','tested_source_sha':S,'started_ns':time.time_ns(),'proposal_sha256':H['digest'](P/'PREPARATION.json'),'default_scan_sha256':H['digest'](E/'s4-document-proposal-scan-v2/PROOF.json'),'applied':[]}
try:
 for x,src,dest in paths:
  assert (H['digest'](dest) if dest.exists() else None)==x['before_sha256']
  dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
  temporary=dest.with_name(dest.name+'.s4-stage')
  assert not temporary.exists() and not temporary.is_symlink()
  with temporary.open('xb') as f: f.write(src.read_bytes())
  temporary.replace(dest)
  assert H['digest'](dest)==x['after_sha256']
  proof['applied'].append(x['path'])
 assert H['git'](R,'rev-parse','HEAD')==S
 proof.update(status='passed',head_unchanged=True,production_changes=False)
except BaseException as error:
 proof.update(status='failed',failure_type=type(error).__name__)
 raise
finally:
 proof['finished_ns']=time.time_ns()
 (O/'PROOF.json').write_text(json.dumps(proof,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'status':proof['status'],'files':len(proof['applied'])}))
